test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )
subject: reasoning
question:
‘A + B’ means ‘A is the father of B’.

‘A * B’ means ‘A is the daughter of B’.

‘A % B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’.

If J + T % N % C * L * S, then how is J related to S?
solution:
The symbols and their meaning used are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ec0bce5055f6385ac622a55bd4a32f6289e563fb2a4d8f5f48b51735a170634.png] 

According to the given information, the family tree is:

J + T % N % C * L * S

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60c06da3ffa7272e8f3ef7f9d9241d4f5f6ee181c79bb757b365a3eff057e4e6.png] 

Thus, J is '**son-in-law**' of S.

Hence, the correct answer is '__option 2__'
